# Veriscope

> The agent's verifiable lens on YouTube. Signed, cite-able video data — REST and MCP — for the agents you ship and the content you publish.

## Primary surfaces

- API (OpenAPI): https://veriscope.ai/openapi.json
- MCP: https://veriscope.ai/mcp  (manifest: /.well-known/mcp.json)
- Agent manifest: /.well-known/ai-plugin.json

## What you can do

- Fetch a signed VideoDoc for any YouTube URL (transcript, chapters, entities, claims, content_hash).
- Semantic search across ingested videos.
- Resolve a timestamp into a verifiable quote.
- Extract and cite claims with supporting quotes.

## Trust

Every response carries `content_hash` (sha256 over normalized transcript) and, on paid plans, an Ed25519 `signature`. Anything generated from a VideoDoc keeps a provenance footer (`source_video_id`, `t`, `quote`, `model`).
